Successful people are delusional.

Self-belief is the most powerful thing.

🚗 Elon Musk & Tesla were written off.
📚 Jeff Bezos quit a stable job to sell books.
🧦 Sara Blakely's original Spanx concept was rejected.

Outsized growth comes from outsized belief.
Set big goals and it forces you to think big everyday.

There are so many obstacles that get in our way.
The only way to smash through them is with real optimism.

Ultimately, it's like that saying:
"Shoot for the stars, you might just land on the moon."

You'll end up achieving so much more this way.

If you want to develop a bit of this delusion, try these 4 things:

1\. Start asking unreasonable questions ❓
↳ This helps you discover insights others won't.

2\. Set unrealistic timeframes ⏳
↳ This forces you to work more efficiently.

3\. Aim to make an absurd amount of money 💰
↳ This, despite what people think, is a great driver early on.

Aim high, but don't beat yourself up about the outcome.
This is the spark that gets you going.

It's about taking the right steps to achieve a better life.

Will you succeed every single time?
Of course not, but you'll learn so much from it.
